name: Metaview
shortDescription: Hiring agents for sourcing and interview notes. Free is $0 per user.
longDescription: Metaview's pricing page lists a free plan at $0 per user per month, AI sourcing with the first 100 profiles free, and a notetaker. The free plan is the listed start.
pricingNotes: A free plan is listed at $0 per user per month and includes AI sourcing with the first 100 profiles free. Other dollar amounts appeared but were not used as the starting paid price.
bestFor: Sourcing profiles and taking interview notes on a free plan
notIdealFor: A company that assumes the free plan covers unlimited sourcing
strength: Metaview lists a free plan at $0 per user per month and AI sourcing with the first 100 profiles free.
weakness: The free sourcing offer stops at 100 profiles, and higher plans were not given a single public starting price here.

useCaseFit.hire-candidates: Free hiring plan with AI sourcing for the first 100 profiles and a notetaker.
